items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: That's with Snow's band... Yeah, it was with Snowden's band

ctx.x: Now, the third show is when he played this "Chinatown." And see, I always did contend, if you got a rhythm section, you play... A rhythm section that doesn't disturb you but keeps on drivin' you, the shit is gonna sound like it's got to go, you know. And they was chugging on his on this "Chinatown," baby, and man...and it just kept on building. It built, you know. He started down, like, here, and then he went to F up there, he went to A out of there, then he went to C out of there, and right when he got to the C,…

And I had to catch four shows, and when I seen that last show, I went out and bought the record. You know, what's a funny thing? I hadn't been... I hadn't been... Well, I was getting jobs, but I wasn't as popular as I was after I learned how to play "Chinatown," and ..(?).. made me Little Jazz. That's with Snow's band... Yeah, it was with
